title: Shaped external fields will reinforce or inhibit ERP-linked responses

statements.text: Appropriately shaped radio frequency or microwave fields that penetrate brain tissue should reinforce or inhibit the motor response normally tied to event-related potentials such as the P300, depending on frequency and phase. This prediction is untested.

sources.quote: should either reinforce of inhibit the motor response normally associated with the ERPs in a frequency and phasedependent manner
